'''Hozumi no Oshimaro''' (穂積忍麻呂) was a {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178|lt=Nara period}} [[:en:Japanese nobility|Japanese nobility]] and {{ill|Kannushi|en|Shinto priest|qid=Q60523|lt=Shinto priest}}. His family name (''kabane'') was [[Asomi]]. He was the second son of [[Outer Senior Eighth Rank, Upper Grade|Outer Senior Eighth Rank, Upper Grade]] [[Hozumi no Noomimaro]]. His court Rank was [[Outer Junior Seventh Rank, Upper Grade|Outer Junior Seventh Rank, Upper Grade]].

== Career ==
During the time of his father, Noomimaro, the family moved to {{ill|Kii Province|en|Kii Province|qid=Q864053|lt=Kii Province}}, where they became priests of the [[Kumano Hayatama Taisha]]. Oshimaro was the first of the [[Hozumi clan]] to be appointed as a {{ill|Negishi|en|negishi|qid=Q364425|lt=Negi}} (Shinto priest) at the shrine. From then on, the descendants of Oshimaro, known as the Kishu-Kumano branch of the Hozumi clan, inherited the position of Negi at the [[Kumano Hayatama Taisha]].
